editorial:
Imagine waking up after a transplant only to find out you can do things no normal human should be able to do. That is exactly what happens to five random strangers who end up with superpowers thanks to a mysterious donor. You will love how the movie balances the weirdness of their new lives with a lot of laughs and high energy. It feels like a wild ride from the start, as these five people have to stop arguing and actually work together to take down a creepy cult leader who wants to steal their powers to become a god. The vibe is lighthearted but has enough stakes to keep you leaning in.

The action scenes are flashy and fun, and the chemistry between the cast makes the dialogue feel real and snappy. While some of the plot twists are a bit predictable, the fast pacing ensures you never get bored. If you enjoy movies that don't take themselves too seriously, you need to see this. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the special effects pop, or just rent it on Apple TV for a cozy movie night at home.
endingExplained: In the final battle, the five heroes realize their powers only work at full strength when they touch and combine their energy. They trap the cult leader in a massive energy loop, stripping him of his stolen abilities and leaving him powerless. The twist is that the mysterious donor was actually a former member of the cult trying to stop the leader from the grave. The team decides to keep their powers to help others in secret.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves superhero teams and lighthearted action movies.
